name: textOnlyWords

versions.rationale: Finds the words a rename by text would rewrite in TypeScript and Svelte where an editor's rename would not: inside strings and after a dot. shadcn-svelte's submit() returns requiredElement('[data-testid="submit"]'), so renaming it by text changed its body too and lost its uid. Such names are no longer rename candidates; finding too many only leaves a name out.

docs:
Every word in `texts` inside a string literal or after a `.`: a rename by text would rewrite them, and an editor's
rename of a top-level declaration never does. It errs towards finding too many (a template's `${}` counts as
string, and so does text between apostrophes in markup), which only leaves a name out of the gate's renames.
